moat_against: Legacy paper volumes face secular digital substitution; RIM growth leans on price, increasingly contested by customers
Data-center moat is thinner: scale-and-power game vs Digital Realty, Equinix and hyperscaler self-builds — IRM is the challenger
Most facility square footage is leased — lease obligations stack on top of $16.3B net debt
Returns do not yet corroborate a wide moat: FY2025 net income only $152M on $6.9B revenue, book equity negative
moat_for: Records storage switching costs: ~93-94% retention, ~14.5-yr average storage duration, compliance/chain-of-custody requirements
Proven pricing power: decades of annual revenue-management increases on the stored base
Global scale: 1,300+ facilities, 240,000+ customers, logistics network sub-scale rivals cannot replicate
Cross-sell: regulated-enterprise relationships seed Digital, ALM and data-center sales
Data-center demand contracted ahead: ~97% leased capacity and signed backlog before new capacity energizes
moat_justification: Moderate-strong: records storage has ~93-94% retention, ~14.5-year average storage duration, compliance/chain-of-custody switching costs, global scale (1,300+ facilities, 240,000+ customers) and proven pricing power, with cross-sell into Digital/ALM/data centers — but legacy volumes face secular digital substitution and growth leans on price, the data-center moat is thinner against Digital Realty/Equinix/hyperscaler self-builds, most facility square footage is leased, and GAAP returns/book equity do not yet corroborate a wide moat through the build cycle.
name: Iron Mountain Incorporated
one_liner: Durable records franchise pivoting to data centers, moat 6/10 — but conservative owner's earnings are negative in 4 of the last 5 years (-$2.10/share TTM through Q2 2026) because ~$2.1B/yr of growth capex exceeds operating cash flow on a $16.3B net-debt balance sheet, so it cannot clear the 15% hurdle at any price on an OE DCF; at $115.00 you are paying for FY2026 guided AFFO of $5.87-5.93/share and a data-center build wave, not for current owner's earnings.
sector: Real Estate / REIT — Records management & data centers
